home.title: KAIROS
home.heroSubline: Kairos keeps your team, your plans and your events in one quiet place — with a few thoughtful AI helpers that take care of the busywork, and always ask before they change a thing.
home.panelUserMessage: Plan the spring launch evening for mid-October, and invite the events team.
home.panelReply: Here’s a gentle plan — three stages, nothing booked until you say so.
home.agentsBody: Just say what you need. Kairos quietly hands it to the right helper, who prepares a draft for you to read. Nothing changes until you approve it — and anything you’ve locked is never shown to the AI.
home.agentsPoint1: One conversation — no need to pick an agent
home.agentsPoint2: Every change arrives as a draft you approve
home.agentConciergeBody: Answers questions, spots risks, points the way.
home.agentPlannerBody: Turns a goal — or a PDF brief — into a clear plan.
home.agentNotesBody: Tidies and summarises notes. Locked ones stay unseen.
home.agentEventsBody: Drafts the event page, ready for your final look.
home.agentBriefBody: A short, quiet summary of the day ahead.
home.teamsBody: Share a single access code and your people are in — each with a role that fits. Tasks, chat and timelines sit together on the same project, so everyone sees the same picture without chasing it.
home.teamsNote: Organizations, teams and your own private space all work the same way, so moving between them feels effortless.
home.eventsBody: When the work is ready, turn it into a public event page with your own images and details. Guests can RSVP and leave comments, and people nearby can find it.
home.eventsNote: The plan and the page live in the same place, so nothing gets copied, lost or out of date.
home.finalSubline: Set up your workspace in a minute. Bring the team in with one code.
home.aboutKairos: About Kairos — getting started, FAQ and contact

onboardingSheet.title: Getting started
onboardingSheet.subtitle: Everything you need to find your way around Kairos — what the surfaces do, the questions people ask, and how to reach us.

steps.dashboard: The dashboard greets you each day with what is due, what is moving and what needs your attention.
steps.projects: Projects hold the plan — tasks, owners and deadlines — so the work and its progress live in one place.
steps.notes: Notes capture the thinking. Draft, share and lock the notes that matter, and recover anything you delete.
steps.calendar: The calendar brings tasks, events and notes onto one timeline you can filter and subscribe to.
steps.orgs: Organizations and shared projects keep a team moving without everyone living in the same task list.
steps.ai: Kairos AI reads your workspace and answers, drafts and nudges — ask it anything from the sparkle icon.

faqItems.a: Kairos is one workspace for coordinating teams, running projects and publishing the events that come out of them.
Yes. Notes can be locked with a PIN, and your workspace is yours unless you choose to share it with an organization.

faqItems.q: How do I recover a deleted note?
faqItems.a: Deleted notes go to recovery. Open the note's menu and choose Recover to bring one back.

team.title: Team
team.personalBody: Just you. Projects, notes and tasks made here stay private until you move them into an organization.
team.orgMeta: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {online} online now
team.viewOnly: You can see who's here and what they can do. Inviting and changing roles is up to the organization's admins.
team.inviteLinksHint: Anyone with the link or code joins with exactly these ticks.
team.noLinks: No live links. Links expire on their own after 1, 7 or 30 days.
team.sentByEmailHint: Waiting for the person to accept.
team.noEmails: Nobody is waiting on an email invite.
team.emailsAdminOnly: Only admins can see email invitations.
team.invitesHidden: Only people who can invite see live invites.
team.roleDescAdmin: Everything, including roles and billing. Keep this to a few people.
team.roleDescMember: Does the work: starts and edits projects, hands out tasks.
team.roleDescMentor: Guides rather than builds. Sees the work without changing it.
team.roleDescGuest: Sees the projects they're added to. Can't change anything.
team.lockedSelf: You can't change your own permissions. Another admin has to.
team.lockedOther: Only admins who can manage roles can change this.
team.lockedNotAdmin: Only admins of this organization can change roles and permissions.
team.pickSomeone: Pick someone to see their role and what they can do.
team.removeSub: They lose access to this organization's projects, notes and chats right away. Their finished work stays.
team.removeFoot: You can invite them again later.
team.leaveSub: You'll stop seeing its projects and chats. Someone will need to invite you to come back.
team.leaveFootActive: You'll be moved to your personal workspace.
team.joinSub: Paste the code someone shared with you.
team.joinHint: Codes come from an invite link or QR. They're case-insensitive.
team.inviteSub: Tick exactly what they'll be able to do, then send it by email or share a link.
team.inviteFoot: Whatever is ticked is what they get on joining.
team.lockedHint: Locked ticks are ones you don't hold yourself, so you can't hand them out.
team.badEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
team.inviteEmailFailed: Invite created for {email}, but the email could not be sent.
team.createSub: A shared home for a team's projects, tasks and chats. You'll be its admin.
team.createFoot: You can invite people right after.
team.emptyBody: An organization is where a team shares projects, tasks, notes and chats. Join one you've been given a code for, or start your own and invite people with exactly the permissions you pick.
team.haveCodeBody: From an invite link or a QR someone showed you. You join with the ticks they chose.
team.startOneBody: You'll be its admin. Invite people right after, by email or with a link.
team.startOneHint: You can rename it or add a logo later.
team.watching: Invitations sent to {email} show up here on their own
team.inviteLede: {name} invited you on {date}. This is exactly what you'd be able to do there; an admin can change it later.
team.inviteLedeAnon: You were invited on {date}. This is exactly what you'd be able to do there; an admin can change it later.
team.otherWays: Join with a code or start your own
team.guideBody: Every person gets a role, and a role is only a starting set of permissions. Admins can tick or untick any of the eight for one person.
team.guidePersonal: Your personal workspace stays yours. Nothing in it moves into an organization unless you move it.
